messages:
marta: Quick ping  I'm sketching an experiment to reduce customer costs by adding a 2-tier fallback path for Dedicated: 'soft-fallback' (same pool, quantized variant) and 'hard-fallback' (shared preemptible pool). Want to capture product constraints and launch checklist.

ajay: 👍 curious about session behavior. Soft-fallback keeps KV/local cache; hard-fallback loses it unless we ship transfer logic. Transfer is non-trivial and risky on multi-turns.

kevin: Implementation note: quantized variant needs a fast kernel switch and model artifact alongside main. Perf delta ~ +20% CPU but latency impact small in my microbench. Will post numbers.

nina: From pricing ops: hard-fallback should be billed differently. Propose a "fallback-minute" meter so customers see cost in real time. Otherwise invoices get confusing.

marta: Agreed. Console should show a per-tenant fallback usage line and estimated cost impact. Also add an opt-in checkbox in onboarding.

rachel: Oncall: add a fallback-surge alert when >5% of tenant traffic is in hard-fallback for 5m. Also track multi-turn failure rate after fallback.

sam: Sales: customers want control knobs. Can we expose a per-route policy: e.g., messages route policy allows soft but disallows hard for chat routes?

ajay: Yes. Policy model: per-tenant, per-route booleans + max_fallback_latency_ms. Example: {allow_soft:true,allow_hard:false,max_latency:450}.

kevin: Data residency: hard-fallback must enforce region eligibility. If tenant has EU-only data, node selection must prevent cross-region routing.

nina: Contractually we should require explicit opt-in to hard-fallback and list which regions are allowed. Sales-bot: ping legal for boilerplate.

sales-bot: legal: tagging @legal-team. Suggest using fixed clause: "Customer consents to routing to approved fallback pools and associated billing".

marta: Pilot idea: pick 2 SMB customers and 1 mid-market. Track metrics for 3 weeks. Success criteria: >=10% cost reduction for users who accept hard-fallback; <5% negative QA signals on canonical prompts; telemetry + billing lines live.

rachel: Add staging test: run a replay that pushes pool to 120% and verify fallback triggers and rollback flow. Also validate rollback latency < 3min.

ajay: Ops note: prewarm logic for hard-fallback pool — we should allow a tenant to prewarm a tiny KV slice when they opt-in to avoid complete session loss. That could be a paid option.

sam: Customers might accept paid session-pin add-on. Good upsell.

kevin: Timeline proposal: prototype quantized artifact + perf (1 sprint), policy + console UI (1 sprint), telemetry + billing meter (1 sprint), pilot (3 weeks).

marta: Owners: kevin runtime, ajay control-plane, nina billing, rachel oncall/runbooks, sam customer recruitment. I'll write a short RFC and PR.

rachel: Runbook must include: how to force-disable fallback per-tenant, how to revoke hard-fallback regionally, and incident play for quality regressions.

ajay: Risk register short: (1) hidden quality regressions -> mitigation: expanded eval prompts + manual checks; (2) billing confusion -> mitigation: visible meter + invoice line; (3) session breakage -> mitigation: default soft-only for chat unless explicit session-pin opt-in.

sales-bot: FYI: flagged a customer last week asking for cost-tiering. Will connect to sam.

marta: OK next steps: I'll post RFC link and schedule a 30m sync. If you have blockers DM me.

kevin: I'll drop perf microbench results here tomorrow.

nina: I'll prototype billing meter event names: fallback.soft_minutes and fallback.hard_minutes and send mapping.

rachel: Once telemetry events land, I'll add dashboards and the >5% alert.

marta: Thanks all. Meeting tomorrow 10:30 to review RFC.
